tasks.title: Add sourceHead and upToDate to GET /api/status
tasks.description: Extend GET /api/status to include sourceHead (live git HEAD in source mode) and upToDate (boolean). Add a getSourceHead() helper in version.ts that runs git rev-parse HEAD in the workingDir from detectInstallMode(). Modify createStatusRoutes to accept versionInfo and compute these fields. Wire versionInfo in server/index.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/status returns sourceHead field (string hash or null)
GET /api/status returns upToDate field (boolean)
In source mode with matching HEAD, upToDate is true
In source mode with differing HEAD, upToDate is false
In non-source mode, sourceHead is null and upToDate is true
Git command failure returns sourceHead null and upToDate true without error
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Design D1: extend existing /api/status rather than new endpoint. Design D5: per-request git rev-parse, not cached.

tasks.title: Add POST /api/settings/system/rebuild endpoint
tasks.description: Create a new rebuild route at POST /api/settings/system/rebuild. It checks source mode (detectInstallMode) and systemd service, returns 400 if unavailable, otherwise returns { success: true } immediately and spawns background build+restart. Extract the build+restart logic from server-systemd.ts updateServer() into a reusable function (spawnRebuild) that runs npm run build in cli and web dirs, then systemctl restart.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/settings/system/rebuild returns { success: true } with 200 in source mode
POST /api/settings/system/rebuild returns 400 in non-source mode
POST /api/settings/system/rebuild returns 400 when systemd not installed
Background build runs npm run build in packages/cli then packages/cli/web
Background build logs failures and does not restart on failure
Successful build triggers systemctl --user restart mohist.service
Route is registered in server/index.ts under /api/settings/system
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Design D2: spawn detached child process, not execSync. Reuse build sequence from server-systemd.ts updateServer(). Import detectInstallMode, isSystemdServiceInstalled, runSystemctlUserSafe from server-systemd.ts.

tasks.title: Add System tab with About section and rebuild button to SettingsPage
tasks.description: Add a 'System' tab to SettingsPage alongside Providers and General. Create SystemSettingsSection component that fetches /api/status to get version/gitHash/sourceHead/upToDate, displays an About section with version info and staleness indicator, and shows a 'Rebuild & Restart' button when upToDate is false and sourceHead is not null. On click, POST /api/settings/system/rebuild, then enter reconnect UX: show 'Rebuilding...' on button, poll /api/health every 5s for up to 60s after connection drops, show 'Restarting... reconnecting in Ns' countdown, refresh version info on reconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: SettingsPage has three tabs: Providers, General, System
System tab shows version, gitHash, and sourceHead in About section
When upToDate is true, shows green 'Up to date' indicator
When upToDate is false, shows amber 'Source changed - rebuild needed' warning
Rebuild & Restart button only appears when sourceHead is not null and upToDate is false
Clicking rebuild button: button changes to 'Rebuilding...' and is disabled
After connection drops: shows 'Restarting... reconnecting in Ns' countdown
Reconnect polls /api/health every 5s, max 60s
On reconnect success: refreshes version info
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Design D3: reconnect via polling /api/health. Design D4: System tab separates About concerns from General config. In non-source mode, shows version info but no rebuild button.
